name: Haunted Hearts
source:
To solve your own murder, you’ll need the help of three ghosts – and the only way to win them over is to seduce them.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
为了侦破你自己被害的谋杀案，你需要借助三只鬼魂的力量——而拉拢他们的唯一办法，便是彻底迷倒他们。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
